shots.text: We had lost twelve cities by then. Solenne was still bright. We thought that meant something.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Solenne at dusk, the Sunstone glowing over a city packed with refugees. Lanterns everywhere. Quiet.

shots.text: At midnight, the Dawn Gate opened from the inside.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The great east gate swinging open. Soldiers in Lanternguard blue standing aside... their eyes empty and grey. Behind the gate, the Unbound pour in.

shots.text: They were soldiers we had fed and armed. He had been keeping them in our own barracks, under our own colours.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Hollowed soldiers fighting in the streets; refugees running; Lanternguard fighting their own.

shots.text: Fennick held the gate. He had a handful of half-built towers, and a hammer, and a temper.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Old Fennick in the gatehouse, spectacles on, firing half-built towers that crackle with unstable elements. Brannoc forging the outer bars shut with his hammer if he is with us.

shots.text:
Spirewright! Fire burns, water slows... and you place them where I tell you.

Go. Get her out.
shots.speaker: fennick
shots.art_note: Fennick shouting over his shoulder, then turning back to the gate as it starts to fall.

shots.text: The gatehouse came down on him. He did not let go of the gate until it did.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The gatehouse collapsing in a cloud of dust and coloured sparks. Silence.

shots.text: Above it all, on the Spire of Aurel, the Lord Marshal raised a blade made from a piece of our Heartstone...
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane at the top of the Spire, his red armour starting to blacken, holding a crystal blade glowing six colours. The Sunstone lens huge above him.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Sunstone shattering. Its pieces fall across the city like burning stars.

shots.text: The light fell on me as I ran. It was the last thing I ever saw.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde in the palace courtyard, looking up as the light falls on her face; white-out. Tamsin dragging her into cover.

shots.text: There is a world without death, Ysolde. I am going to bring her home. I am going to bring all of them home.
shots.speaker: cassivane
shots.art_note: Cassivane, ash drifting from his armour, stepping through a rip of darkness at the top of the Spire, carrying the Sunstone's shards in a net of grey light.

shots.text: Not all of the shards went with him. One of them fell east, and did not land. Nobody saw it but me... and I did not know what I had seen.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Over the dark city, one falling shard of white light drifts sideways, east, toward the distant Rift, and keeps going.

shots.text:
When the sun should have risen, it did not.

That was the beginning of the Long Night.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Dawn hour. A black sky over Solenne. Only torches. Refugees looking up.
